analyses.statisticalComment: P-value was obtained from the Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test stratified by ongoing PV therapy.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Response was defined as absence of phlebotomy eligibility. Phlebotomy eligibility was defined as either: 1) A confirmed hematocrit (HCT) greater than or equal to (≥) 45% that was at least 3% higher than the baseline HCT, where confirmation was defined as 2 consecutive HCT assessments that were ≥ 45% and at least 3% higher than the baseline HCT, or 2) HCT ≥ 48%.

groups.description: Participants received their ongoing therapy for PV along with rusfertide matching placebo, SC injection, once weekly, from baseline up to Week 32.

groups.description: Participants received their ongoing therapy for PV along with rusfertide once weekly, SC injection from baseline up to Week 32. Rusfertide doses were titrated to maintain hematocrit \< 45%. The starting dose was 19 mg. The doses that were administered to Part 1a participants were 9.5, 19, 28, 41, 54, 69 and 82 mg.
